sections.name: 10-K Item
sections.context: Lumentum Holdings Inc. annual report (10-K) for fiscal 2026: Item 1A. Risk Factors

facts.text: Lumentum depends on a limited number of suppliers for raw materials, packages, and components; some are sole sources for certain materials, equipment, and components. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Supplier concentration is a key risk factor; alternative sources are not always feasible.

Lumentum has not entered into long-term agreements with many of its suppliers and lacks guaranteed supply, though it has made advanced payments to secure orders from some suppliers. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Highlights lack of contractual supply security.

China's export controls affected the availability and price of rare earth metals and other critical minerals, adversely impacting Lumentum's operations, margins, and sales as well as its supply chain and customers. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Specific example of geopolitical/export control risk affecting input costs and operations.

Lumentum is exposed to risk from increasing or fluctuating market prices of certain raw materials, with past and potential future impacts from tariffs, inflation, trade restrictions, and other supply chain constraints. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Identifies commodity/input cost volatility as an ongoing risk factor.

Lumentum depends on a limited number of suppliers for raw materials, packages and components, some of which are sole sources, and lacks long-term agreements or guaranteed supply with many of them. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Identifies key supply chain dependency risk.

China's export controls affected the availability and price of rare earth metals and other critical minerals for Lumentum and its supply chain and customers, adversely affecting operations, margins and sales. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Specific named trade-policy risk impacting materials supply and financials.

Lumentum has made advanced payments to secure orders from some of these limited/sole-source suppliers but has not entered into long-term agreements with many of them. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Describes contracting approach to mitigate supply risk.

facts.text: Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) describes itself as a global leader in optical and photonic technologies for AI, cloud computing, and next-generation communications, headquartered in San Jose, California, with R&D, manufacturing, and sales facilities worldwide. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Company self-description establishes core business and product scope

Lumentum highlights transition to optical links in data center architecture and accelerating AI demand as key market drivers and growth opportunities. | When: Q4 FY2026 (as of August 11, 2026) | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Key forward-looking demand thesis explicitly stated by the company

Lumentum's forward-looking statements are subject to risks including: macroeconomic uncertainty, geopolitical conflicts, tariffs, duties and export controls (including on certain rare earth minerals); quarter-over-quarter product mix fluctuations that materially impact profitability due to broad gross margin ranges; declining average selling prices or cost increases that compress margins; seasonality; ability to increase manufacturing capacity and ability of suppliers/contract manufacturers to meet production, quality, and delivery requirements for forecasted demand; and changes in customer demand including from inventory changes. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Material risk factors disclosed that could impact future results, including supply chain (rare earth minerals), manufacturing capacity constraints, and customer demand/inventory dependencies

Lumentum provides forward-looking guidance on net revenue, non-GAAP diluted earnings per share, and non-GAAP operating margin, along with a target model for revenue and stated total addressable market. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Indicates the financial metrics the company guides on; specific figures not provided in this chunk

Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE) describes itself as a global leader in optical and photonic technologies serving AI, cloud computing, and next-generation communications, delivering high-performance lasers, modules, and optical subsystems for data center connectivity, telecom, industrial manufacturing, and sensing. | Involving: Lumentum Holdings Inc. | Company self-description establishes core business and product categories for context.
